subject: Residential District Zoning Amendments
overview: The board conducted a detailed review of proposed residential zoning changes and introduced an interactive mapping tool for public use. The hearing was continued to May 21, 2025, to allow staff to incorporate board and public feedback regarding density and height requirements.

items.title: Residential Zoning Amendments and Mapping Tool
items.summary: The board continued the public hearing on proposed amendments for neighborhood and urban residential zoning and reviewed a new interactive mapping tool developed by Innes Associates.

items.title: Residential District Standards and Historic Conversions
items.summary: Consultants presented updated dimensional requirements for five residential districts and proposed rules allowing the conversion of historic houses into multi-unit dwellings based on total floor area.

items.title: Public Comment on Density and Neighborhood Character
items.summary: Public testimony primarily focused on requests for higher density near transit and commercial squares, while some residents expressed concern regarding neighborhood character and parking requirements.

items.title: Board Deliberations and Hearing Continuance
items.summary: The board requested that consultants explore options for more aggressive upzoning in specific districts and voted to continue the public hearing to May 21, 2025.

items.title: Routine Business and Zoning Updates
items.summary: The board approved the minutes from April 16, 2025, and received reports on forthcoming hearings regarding accessory dwelling units and city squares.
